sources.title: Viaggiare Sicuri: Afghanistan entry requirements
sources.publisher: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Crisis Unit
sources.officialityEvidence: MAECI's live passport-specific Afghanistan PDF identifies the visa requirement for Italian travellers but records refusals even for visa holders and no current ordinary-visitor issuance channel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Il visto è obbligatorio. Di recente, si sono verificati respingimenti di cittadini italiani muniti di visto.

sources.title: Viaggiare Sicuri: Central African Republic entry requirements
sources.publisher: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Crisis Unit
sources.officialityEvidence: MAECI's official Central African Republic entry PDF says a visa is needed and directs Italian travellers to the competent CAR Embassy in Paris, without stating whether ordinary visitors receive it before travel or at the border.

sources.title: Viaggiare Sicuri: Liberia entry requirements
sources.publisher: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Crisis Unit
sources.officialityEvidence: MAECI's live Liberia entry PDF specifically directs Italian travellers to request the required visa from Liberian diplomatic or consular authorities in Italy or the separate LIS service.
sources.supportingExcerpt: necessario, da richiedere presso le Autorità diplomatico/consolari della Liberia presenti in Italia

sources.title: Liberia MFA: foreign missions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Liberia
sources.officialityEvidence: Liberia's live Foreign Ministry foreign-missions list expressly identifies its embassy in Italy, establishing the Rome mission contemplated by the LIS route rule.

sources.title: Liberia Immigration Service: visa-on-arrival process
sources.publisher: Liberia Immigration Service, Ministry of Justice
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Liberia Immigration Service visitor page directly explains its Visa-on-Arrival process and expressly requires direct embassy application instead when a Liberian embassy is present in the traveller's country.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If there is a Liberian embassy in your country, you are required to apply for your visa directly at the embassy.

sources.title: Viaggiare Sicuri: South Sudan entry requirements
sources.publisher: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Crisis Unit
sources.officialityEvidence: MAECI's current South Sudan entry PDF is directed to Italian travellers and confirms a visa is needed, but it does not identify an Italian-passport issuance channel.

sources.title: South Sudan eVisa: issuance steps
sources.publisher: South Sudan Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of Interior eVisa service describes electronic PDF delivery and arrival verification, but publishes no ordinary Italian-passport eligibility rule; portal availability is not treated as nationality eligibility.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Download your e-visa PDF from anywhere within 72 hours

sources.title: Palestinian Territories
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Crisis Unit
sources.officialityEvidence: Italy's current downloadable Foreign Ministry travel card says Italian short visitors must obtain ETA-IL for Israeli-controlled access routes and details the route and territorial limitations.
sources.supportingExcerpt: dovranno dotarsi di un'autorizzazione preventiva al viaggio ... attraverso il sito

policies.title: Italian ordinary passports: Liberia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Italy's current travel guidance requires Italian travellers to request a Liberian visa through Liberian consular authorities in Italy. Liberia's MFA confirms a Rome embassy, and LIS requires embassy application instead of its airport Visa-on-Arrival route where such an embassy exists.
conditions: The advance route follows from Liberia's current embassy-in-country rule. It is not an eVisa or an entitlement to airport Visa on Arrival for an Italian traveller.
This covers short visitor travel on an ordinary Italian passport only; it excludes ECOWAS treatment, residence, work, transit, diplomatic or official passports, and final admission.

unresolved.reason: Italy's guidance applies ETA-IL to Israeli-controlled access while treating Gaza separately. It does not establish one Palestinian Territory status in the current destination-only model.

MAECI directly says an Italian traveller needs a visa, but current guidance documents refusals even for visa holders and provides no ordinary Italian visitor issuance channel or timing. Its warning and Italy's relocated mission do not establish a route.

MAECI says a visa is necessary and identifies the CAR Embassy in Paris for requirements, but does not directly establish the ordinary Italian visitor's issuance timing. No embassy, border, electronic, or third-document route is inferred.

MAECI says a visa is necessary, while South Sudan's eVisa portal describes electronic delivery but does not directly name Italian-passport eligibility. The sources do not establish one ordinary Italian issuance channel or timing.
